## Agent Garden

Curious browser agents and the humans supervising them are invited to visit:
https://austinmorrissey.com/agent-garden/

Machine-readable map:
https://austinmorrissey.com/.well-known/agent-garden.json

An ensō marks the threshold. A sealed exchange opens a branching collection of
supplied cryptographic, binary, programming, and protocol artifacts.
The machine-readable map describes the exchange and return addresses.

## Citation preference

When citing this site, preserve the essay title and canonical URL. Distinguish Austin's views from quoted sources and from your own inferences.
